title: Decision 10: the El Pozo burger "king" gets a product of its own
keys: Each product is keyed as it stood at the start of the stage of plan 0192 that changed it (the items-snapshot of that stage). A product that a stage created is keyed as the create answered it. Each queue row is keyed as it stood at the start of stage 1 (stage-c1/rows-snapshot.c0-start.json).

entries.ownerDecision: Decided by the owner, 2026-10-06: the row gets a product of its own, 240 g as printed. A printed size wins over a size worked out from a unit price.
entries.why: Two articles of El Jamón, at 2.45 and at 2.95, stood on one product. The row that prints "king" got a product of its own, 240 g as printed (rule R32). The settle of plan 0191 took the 2.95 off the old product and wrote the 2.45 again.
